services.hero.title: Our Programs & Pricing
services.hero.subtitle: Choose the program that fits your child. All sessions are with certified coaches.

services.semi.desc: Great for siblings or friends at similar skill level. Parents arrange their own pairs for a focused, social learning experience.

plans.hero.subtitle: Every swimmer is different. Choose the format that fits your schedule, goals, and budget — all with the same expert coaching.
plans.private.title: 1-on-1 Private
plans.private.desc: Dedicated one-on-one time with a coach. Fastest way to build technique and confidence, tailored entirely to your child's pace.
plans.semi.title: 1-on-2 Semi-Private
plans.semi.meta: 30 minutes · Parents find their own partner
plans.semi.desc: Share a lesson with one other swimmer. Great value when paired with a sibling or friend — same focused coaching, split across two students.
plans.group.title: 1-on-4 Group
plans.group.desc: Structured group classes with up to 4 students. Book online and see real-time availability.
plans.group.note: Purchase a session pack and book online anytime. Credits are valid from the date of purchase.

plans.team.desc: Competitive swim training for dedicated swimmers. Focus on stroke technique, endurance, turns, and race strategy.
plans.team.autoPlace: Your swimmer is placed automatically based on their swim level.
plans.team.note: Monthly membership per swimmer — renews automatically until cancelled. Contact us anytime to cancel.
